headlines.title: Los Angeles Lakers sold to Bob Iger, Josh Kushner for $12 billion
headlines.description: The Los Angeles Lakers are being sold to an ownership group led by Josh Kushner and Bob Iger, the businessmen confirmed to NBC News on Wednesday.

headlines.title: Bumble scraps signature rule and now allows men to make first move on dating app
headlines.description: Dating app Bumble announced on Tuesday that it would be getting rid of its hallmark rule that prevents men from making the first move.

headlines.title: Inflation remained stubborn in July as wages slowed for workers
headlines.description: The government released the consumer price index for July as Americans contend with a tight labor market and elevated energy costs.

headlines.title: Lakers to be sold to Bob Iger and Josh Kushner for $12 billion
headlines.description: The Los Angeles Lakers are being sold to an ownership group led by Josh Kushner and former Disney CEO Bob Iger reportedly for a $12.5 billion. NBC News' Steve Patterson reports on the new ownership group buying the franchise that had just been bought in late 2025.

headlines.title: Jackpot for Powerball Officially Breaks $1 Billion Mark
headlines.description: If you're ready to test your luck, the Powerball jackpot has officially broken the billion-dollar barrier. It comes after no winning tickets were sold for Monday night's massive drawing. It's just the second time in under a year that the grand prize has eclipsed the billion-dollar mark.

headlines.title: Back-to-School Shopping: What to Know Before Hitting the Stores
headlines.description: For 2026, back-to-school spending for grades K-12 is expected to hit an average of $863, up slightly from 2025, and a record $1,400 for college students. But before you go shopping, NBC’s Christine Romans stops by TODAY to share ways to save, including offerings from Walmart, Target, Staples and Amazon. She also shares strategies for comparing prices, buying refurbished tech and more.

headlines.title: Outlets Don’t Always Offer the Best Deals: Where to Find Bargains
headlines.description: It’s back-to-school season and outlet stores and malls are in high demand, but are they really delivering the best prices? NBC’s Christine Romans joins TODAY to share shopping strategies to find better deals elsewhere. Tips include checking clearance sections, using browser extensions for coupons and more.

headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.

headlines.title: Gas cost calculator: How much have higher gas prices cost you?
headlines.description: Americans have spent an estimated $40 billion more in gas since the Iran war started. According to an NBC News analysis, drivers who fill up twice a month paid anywhere from $20 to $300 more for gas.

headlines.title: U.S. economy lost 23,000 jobs in July, a sudden reversal for the labor market
headlines.description: The U.S. economy shed 23,000 jobs in July, a sign that the labor market had not stabilized after four months of positive growth.

headlines.title: Federal Communications Commission scraps limit on broadcast TV ownership
headlines.description: The Federal Communications Commission voted to eliminate a cap on the share of U.S. television households a single company can reach.

headlines.title: Map: How much you pay in federal and state gas taxes
headlines.description: As national gas price averages head toward $5 per gallon, one state has already suspended its gas tax, and now President Donald Trump and his Cabinet are talking about doing the same.
